q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a poultry processing plant per kg?
title: Poultry processing footprint per kg
short: Add the plant's electricity, boiler fuel and refrigerant top-ups for a period and divide by kg of dressed product packed. Add the live birds from the farm's own figure, which is usually most of the total, and the packaging.
audience: Poultry processing plants and their buyers

ul: Scalding water heating and boiler fuel.
Chilling, blast freezing and cold storage electricity.
Refrigerant top-ups, counted from kg recharged times the gas's GWP.
Live birds per kg of dressed product, with the farm's figure.
Effluent treatment and rendering of by-products.

p: Report per kg dressed, and say how emissions were shared with by-products such as feathers and offal.

example.title: Worked example: processing plant per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 105,700 / 400,000 = 0.264 kg CO2 per kg
Add live birds and packaging for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
